environment.name: Sunlit pond
environment.description: Light and minerals support producers; organic food comes from living cells and their remains.

populations.name: Phototroph
populations.description: Build photosynthetic units and transporters, using paid light and chemical sensors.

populations.name: Forager
populations.description: Approach small visible objects and local organic cues; slide away from resistant surfaces.

populations.name: Mixotroph
populations.description: Share finite internal space between light harvesting and contact feeding.

populations.name: Predator
populations.description: Approach visible objects when hungry and test contacted surfaces with a built piercer.
